_notes.purpose: Week renders for WeekHeroImage / HeroSubject (public/assets/semanas/bebe-<week>.webp, weeks 3–42). Transparent PNG sources; convert with npm run optimize:images per public/assets/semanas/README.md. Plus the 40 size-comparison objects (public/assets/comparaciones/<slug>.webp, slugs from lib/seed/comparisons.ts) regenerated 2026-09-23 on a transparent background — the 2026-09-21 set sat on coloured squares and never reached the repo.
_notes.style: Flat editorial picture-book illustration matching the 40 size-comparison fruits. Weeks 3–4 glow/seed, 5–8 embryo, 9–42 the same curled baby. 2026-09-28: weeks 16, 18, 26 and 28–42 regenerated with week 22 as style reference (thin outlines fixed; the swaddled 28–42 replaced: a baby in the womb is not in a blanket). The per-week size story is the comparison object, not the baby drawing.
_notes.resolution_rule: 1:1 medium 1k — shown at most ~300 px wide on phones.
_notes.cost_preflight: 0.5 credits per image (gpt_image_2_5 sunburst, medium, 1k, 1:1, transparent)
_notes.actual_spend_credits: ~42.5 (weeks: 40 kept + 3 blocked + 2 superseded pilots ≈ 22.5; comparisons: 40 kept = 20; blocked or rate-limited submissions are not charged)
_notes.review: Founder to approve both sets in the Higgsfield gallery before localizing; medical reviewer optional (stylised, non-anatomical).
_notes.site_set_in_repo: 2026-09-27, growth plan item 7: public/assets/semanas/bebe-<week>.webp currently holds the site's 42 opaque size illustrations (scripts/import-site-week-art.mjs), shown framed (lib/hero/weekArt.ts WEEK_ART_STYLE='framed').
